hooks.command: jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | test("\\.b64$")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: payload/*.b64 is gzip+base64 — unreadable and ~2k tokens per file. Decode first: base64 -d FILE | gzip -dc > /tmp/af-work/NAME.py, then read the .py. See CLAUDE.md."}} else {} end'

jq -c 'if ((.tool_input.command // "") | test("(^|[;&|]|\\bdo |\\bthen )[[:space:]]*(cat|head|tail|less|more|bat|nl|xxd|od|strings|sed|awk)\\b[^|;&\\n]*\\.b64")) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Blocked: dumping a payload/*.b64 file burns ~2k tokens of unreadable base64.
